text_block_list.text:
Some time after the fiercely contested
U.A.F. Finals had concluded—

The ripple effects of competing in the U.A.F.
were beginning to show around <chrname>.

text_block_list.name: Fan Letter
text_block_list.text:
"I first saw <chrname>-san in action
at the 'U.A.F.',
and I became an instant fan!"

text_block_list.name: Fan Letter
text_block_list.text: "After that, I watched videos of <chrname>-san's past races, and I ended up totally hooked on that too—"

text_block_list.name: Fan Letter
text_block_list.text:
"‘Next time I'll be cheering for <chrname>-san
at the racetrack! Good luck!’"

text_block_list.name: Fan Letter
text_block_list.text:
"'I was deeply moved by how amazing
<chrname>-san was in the U.A.F.'"

text_block_list.name: Fan Letter
text_block_list.text:
"I will always support you, <chrname>-san,
in races and everywhere else.
You are my absolute favorite for life!"

And so, thanks to the U.A.F.,
many new fans who came to know <chrname>
began appearing.

Not only did she gain valuable experience as an athlete,
but she was also able to win over new fans who
now cheer her on, which is truly wonderfulâ

I hoped that the U.A.F. would continue to be
a shining stage for many athlete Umamusume in the future.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: “—Thank you all very much for waiting!”

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
"And now!
We would like to make a huuuuuge announcement
regarding the "U.A.F."!!!"

text_block_list.name: Suzuka & Elfi
text_block_list.text: "Ready, set, go!!"

text_block_list.name: Suzuka & Elfi
text_block_list.text: "The 2nd U.A.F. has been confirmed!!"
(Clap clap clap clap clap clap clap—!)

text_block_list.name: Stream Comment
text_block_list.text:
"I can't wait!!"
"Staff, please give us more broadcast slots next time!"
"Ooh~! They're really doing it again!!"

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks to the overwhelming support we received,
we will be expanding the scale of 'U.A.F.' and holding a second edition."

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks to all your support, believe it or not!
We've even received word from international athlete Umamusume saying, 'I want to participate!'!!"

text_block_list.name: Stream Comment
text_block_list.text:
"Overseas!?" "You mean a world tournament?"
"The scale suddenly got huge~!"
"I wanna see them take on Japanese athletes!"

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
"And that's not all! There's even talk
coming from that legendary superstar Umamusume
that everyone knows about!!"

text_block_list.name: Stream Comment
text_block_list.text:
"Ooooh, who's going to show up?!"
"The management is really raising the bar here!"
"So exciting!"

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: "The U.A.F. is a stage where the supreme Umamusume athletes compete, and at the same time—"

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: "It is also a stage for you to shine once more."

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: "‘Whether you shine brightly as an athlete today, or shone in the past, U.A.F. welcomes all of you equally.’"

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: "'This competition will continue to broaden the horizons of our athlete Umamusume—'"

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
"I promise to deliver the ultimate entertainment,
bringing a hot, dazzling sparkle to you all."

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
"Now, to all you aspiring athlete Umamusume out there!
Whoever thinks they've got what it takes!!"

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
"Let's sweat and shine together!
Connecting through the power of sports!!"

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
"The U.A.F. awaits
your challenge."

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: "And now, onto a new stage!!"

text_block_list.name: Suzuka & Elfi
text_block_list.text: "U.A.F., ready... GO!!"
